reviews.note: The Korean templates are presentation translations of the current frozen Chinese source. They are not asserted to be byte-identical official Korean client strings.

The pinned legacy Korean presentation uses inclusive wording such as 이상/이하 for these effects, while the current frozen source uses strict 高于/大于/小于. Stage D follows the current frozen source using 보다 높음/미만 and does not let the legacy presentation override semantics.
Legacy Korean presentation spelling varies. Stage D chooses one site display spelling without treating the wording as canonical semantic identity.
Legacy Korean pages are used only for phrase/terminology cross-check. Stage D references the frozen parameterSequenceId and never copies legacy level values.

nextStartPoint: Validate B/C/D presentation coverage as one exact-ID localization set and admit a frozen localization consumer without copying or recomputing TrainingTech semantic values. Then frontend integration can consume that frozen presentation artifact.
reopenConditions: Stage C predecessor blob identity changes.
The frozen COMMON_PASSIVE effect extraction blob identity changes or membership is no longer exactly 46.
Any translated template fails placeholder count/order or rich-text wrapper parity against its frozen source template.
A direct official Korean source contradicts a display template in a way that requires presentation correction.
Localization or Project Check owning validator reports a hard failure.
